metric1_ge7_ge8_coverage.note: scalars = whole-run aggregate (bench ~0.99 / ~0.92); timeline_* split ge7/ge8 over wall-time bins so a SEGMENTED episode (ge7 -> ~0 for a stretch) is distinct from a uniformly-low baseline — only the former carries the collision signal G1 needs.
